body.statement:
In the fixed-dimensional exact-real computational model in which the class-dependent finite library of representative summaries is precomputed, \(\widehat\nu_n^{\mathrm{net}}\) is a total Borel map with values in the positive real probability laws having at most \(k\) atoms.  The library has cardinality at most
\[
C\,n^{(4d_zd_x+d_x)/2},
\]
and exhaustive nearest-library search, including formation of \(\widehat S_n\), uses at most \(C\{n+n^{(4d_zd_x+d_x)/2}\}\) fixed-dimensional arithmetic, comparison, singular-value, and fixed-degree root-isolation operations.  Singular-value thresholding at \(\pi_0\sigma_0^2/2\) retains exactly the \(k\)-dimensional signal space for every stored representative and remains correct under operator perturbations smaller than \(\pi_0\sigma_0^2/2\).  For every \(P\in\mathcal M\), the deterministic inequality
\[
W_1(\widehat\nu_n^{\mathrm{net}},\nu_P)
\le C_{\mathrm{mod}}\left\{2d_S(\widehat S_n,S(P))+n^{-1/2}\right\}
\]
holds.  Consequently this explicit finite-library estimator has a collision-uniform root-\(n\) high-probability guarantee, without diagonalizing a possibly nonreal empirical compressed spectrum.
body.proof_tex:
Let \(D:=4d_zd_x+d_x\), \(b:=4\sqrt{d_zd_x}+\sqrt{d_x}\), and \(\epsilon_n:=n^{-1/2}\).  The observed-margin proposition puts every scalar coordinate of \(q\in\mathscr S\) in \([-L,L]\).  If two summaries lie in one coordinate cube of side \(a\), the Frobenius bound for each matrix and the Euclidean bound for the vector give
\[
d_S(q,q')\le ba.                                                               \tag{100}
\]
Thus cubes of side at most \(\epsilon_n/b\) provide an \(\epsilon_n\)-net, and their number is at most
\[
\left(2+\frac{2Lb}{\epsilon_n}\right)^D\le Cn^{D/2}.                         \tag{101}
\]

At a stored representative \(q=S(P_q)\), the stacked proxy matrix has rank \(k\), \(k\)-th singular value at least \(s_0:=\pi_0\sigma_0^2\), and all remaining singular values zero.  Thresholding at \(s_0/2\) therefore returns an orthonormal basis \(V\) of \(\operatorname{col}B\).  Put \(R:=B^\top V\).  The proxy and outcome-weighted factorizations give
\[
M_tV=A_t\operatorname{diag}(w_t)R,qquad
N_tV=A_t\operatorname{diag}(w_t)\operatorname{diag}(\mu_t)R.
\]
Every factor before \(R\) has full column rank, so the Penrose equations imply
\[
\Delta=R^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(\tau_1,\ldots,\tau_k)R.                    \tag{102}
\]
Also \(m_X=Bp\) and the anchor gives \(B^\top e_1=\mathbf1_k\), whence
\[
a^\top=p^\top R,qquad c=R^{-1}\mathbf1_k.                                   \tag{103}
\]
For every distinct eigenvalue \(\lambda\), its polynomial projector is
\[
E_\lambda=R^{-1}\operatorname{diag}\{\mathbf1(\tau_u=\lambda)\}R,
\]
and (103) gives
\[
a^\top E_\lambda c=\sum_{u:\tau_u=\lambda}p_u.                              \tag{104}
\]
Thus every representative returns exactly \(F(q)=\nu_{P_q}\), a positive real probability law supported on \([-L_{\tau},L_{\tau}]\), with coincident effects aggregated.

For any \(P\in\mathcal M\), select a representative \(q_0\) with \(d_S(q_0,S(P))\le\epsilon_n\).  Nearest-library optimality gives
\[
d_S(\widehat q_n,S(P))
\le d_S(\widehat q_n,\widehat S_n)+d_S(\widehat S_n,S(P))
\le\epsilon_n+2d_S(\widehat S_n,S(P)).                                       \tag{105}
\]
Both summaries lie in \(\mathscr S\), so the gap-free modulus and (104)--(105) prove
\[
W_1(\widehat\nu_n^{\mathrm{net}},\nu_P)
\le C_{\mathrm{mod}}\{2d_S(\widehat S_n,S(P))+n^{-1/2}\}.                   \tag{106}
\]
The uniform concentration lemma supplies the root-\(n\) high-probability conclusion.

For measurability, the event that a fixed representative is the first distance minimizer is a finite intersection of Borel inequalities between continuous functions of \(\widehat S_n\).  Hence the finite-valued selector is Borel; the empty-class fallback is constant.  For threshold stability, the variational inequality
\[
|\sigma_j(G+H)-\sigma_j(G)|\le\lVert H\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}                  \tag{107}
\]
shows that \(\lVert H\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}<s_0/2\) leaves exactly \(k\) singular values above the threshold.  Forming \(\widehat S_n\) takes \(O(n)\) fixed-dimensional operations, exhaustive distance evaluation takes \(O(n^{D/2})\), and the selected representative requires only fixed-size singular-value, compression, and degree-at-most-\(k\) root-isolation operations.  This proves the operation count in the precomputed-library exact-real model.  Since diagonalization occurs only at an admissible stored representative, nonreal eigenvalues of a raw empirical compressed operator are never evaluated.
body.justification: The finite-library estimator attains the same collision-uniform rate with online polynomial operation count when class-dependent admissible-summary representatives are precomputed.
body.gap: The finite-library search exposes polynomial online computation at the modulus scale, but its representative library is class-dependent precomputed advice and is not supplied by the data alone.
body.consumer: It provides an advised computational alternative and does not claim exact computation of the full confidence or cluster report.
